status: Author-proofreading package; no journal submission authorized
format_reason: The requested concise contribution fits Brief Communications better than the journal's 500-word, four-reference Letter category. Two pages describes this author proof, not guaranteed publisher pagination.
supplement_plan: One main table and two supporting tables; standalone TSV, FASTA and PDF/DOCX files for review. ZIP is an additional reproduction convenience, not the sole data supplement.
cost_note: Guide lists a mandatory 90 USD fee per published page. No charge or submission is authorized here.
editorial_fit: Brief contribution about sequence curation and design sensitivity; computational-only scope may limit editorial interest. Format compliance is not an acceptance prediction.

citations.claim: Fusion-junction ASOs have been experimentally tested in another cancer.
citations.boundary: Does not establish EMC efficacy or selective cleavage. The most active ESAS2 targeted the initiation region and also affected normal EWS.

citations.claim: Oligonucleotide enumeration and normal-transcript screening are established methods.
citations.boundary: Our contribution is not a new screening algorithm.

citations.claim: USZ20 and USZ22 model reports and Figure 4 sequence annotations.
citations.boundary: Only a reference reconstruction is assigned for USZ20; USZ22 exact junction remains unresolved.

citations.claim: Simple sequence counts alone do not establish biological selectivity.
citations.boundary: Different chemistry and gap lengths; no validation of our proposed LNA/6-DNA-gap ranking.
